title: Possible error in the text about <input type="range">
body:
https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#range-state-(type=range)

> For example, the markup <input type=​"range" min=​0 max=​100 step=​20 value=​50> results in a range control whose initial value is 60\.

But

> The default value is the [minimum](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#concept-input-min) plus half the difference between the [minimum](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#concept-input-min) and the [maximum](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#concept-input-max), unless the [maximum](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#concept-input-max) is less than the [minimum](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#concept-input-min), in which case the [default value](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#concept-input-value-default-range) is the [minimum](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#concept-input-min).

and

> The value content attribute gives the default [value](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#concept-fe-value) of the [input](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#the-input-element) element. When the [value](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#attr-input-value) content attribute is added, set, or removed, if the control's [dirty value flag](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#concept-fe-dirty) is false, the user agent must set the [value](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#concept-fe-value) of the element to the [value](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#attr-input-value) of the value content attribute, if there is one, or the empty string otherwise, and then run the current [value sanitization algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#value-sanitization-algorithm), if one is defined.


I'm not entirely sure what usually works first here, but is the initial value 60 accurate?
